title: Crafting Ore MOD
description: Need ore but don’t feel like going mining? This mod lets you craft eight types of ore: coal, iron, lapis lazuli, emerald, redstone, gold, diamond, and netherite.
body:
We’ve added crafting recipes for a total of 8 types of ores: coal, iron, gold, redstone, emerald, lapis lazuli, diamond, and netherite.
It’s easy to make! Just arrange sticks in a cross shape, leaving a space in the center, and place a dye of the same color in that space.
